derived_quantities.description: Higher of actual weight and the 25 kg minimum chargeable weight

charges.label: Freight on chargeable weight
charges.quote: consignments under 50 kg: ₹9.50 per kg of chargeable weight; consignments over 50 kg: ₹8.25 per kg of chargeable weight

charges.label: Fragile protected handling
charges.quote: Consignments booked as fragile are handled under the Carrier's protected-handling process at ₹150.00 per consignment, in addition to freight.

accessorials_policy.clause: alpine-express.md (no clause declares unlisted charges not payable)

invoice_adjustments.label: 5% volume discount on invoice total
invoice_adjustments.quote: In any calendar month in which the Customer tenders more than 12 consignments, the Carrier will apply a 5% discount to the invoice total for that month's invoice.

document_rules.rule: Carrier invoices monthly; payment due 30 days from invoice date.
Rate revisions require 60 days' written notice and take effect from the first day of the following calendar month.

ambiguities.description: Rates are given for consignments 'under 50 kg' (₹9.50/kg) and 'over 50 kg' (₹8.25/kg); a consignment of exactly 50 kg chargeable weight is covered by neither band.

notes: Band test uses chargeable weight; for §2 this is equivalent to actual weight since the 25 kg minimum is below the 50 kg break. No charges for cold_chain, residential or express are listed; express is not offered (§3). No credit-note, dispute-window or closed-list clauses in the contract.
